title: Software Architect

nodes.title: Software Design Principles: SOLID & GRASP
nodes.subtitle: Single Responsibility, Open/Closed, Liskov Substitution, Interface Segregation, Dependency Inversion
learning_objectives: Refactor legacy codebases adhering to SOLID principles to maximize maintainability
Apply the Dependency Inversion Principle to decouple high-level policy from low-level details
feynman_prompts: Explain why violating the Liskov Substitution Principle causes unexpected runtime crashes when subclassing.
key_misconceptions: Treating design patterns as rigid dogma to be forced into every trivial class

nodes.title: Domain-Driven Design (DDD): Strategic Design
nodes.subtitle: Ubiquitous Language, Bounded Contexts, Context Mapping, Core Domain vs Generic Subdomains
learning_objectives: Establish a shared Ubiquitous Language between domain experts and software engineers
Decompose enterprise systems into clean, decoupled Bounded Contexts using Context Mapping
feynman_prompts: What is a Bounded Context in DDD and why is sharing a single unified data model across an enterprise toxic?
key_misconceptions: Creating an enormous enterprise-wide 'Canonical Data Model' that attempts to model everything

nodes.title: DDD Tactical Patterns: Aggregates, Entities & Value Objects
nodes.subtitle: Entities vs Value Objects, Aggregate Roots, invariant enforcement, Domain Events, Repositories
learning_objectives: Design rich domain models where Aggregate Roots strictly enforce consistency boundaries
Model immutable Value Objects that encapsulate business validation rules
feynman_prompts: Why must external services only interact with an Aggregate through its Aggregate Root?
key_misconceptions: Creating anemic domain models that are just bags of getters and setters with zero business logic

nodes.title: Architectural Styles: Modular Monolith vs Microservices
nodes.subtitle: Monolith First, Modular Monoliths, Microservices trade-offs, Conway's Law, distributed tax
learning_objectives: Evaluate the high organizational and operational cost (distributed tax) of microservices
Architect strict in-process boundaries in a Modular Monolith before splitting into services
feynman_prompts: How does Conway's Law dictate that software architecture inevitably reflects team communication structures?
key_misconceptions: Defaulting to microservices for early-stage startups before product-market fit and domain understanding

nodes.title: Clean Architecture & Hexagonal (Ports & Adapters)
nodes.subtitle: Dependency Rule, Entities, Use Cases, Interface Adapters, Frameworks & Drivers, Ports & Adapters
learning_objectives: Structure enterprise applications where business logic has zero dependencies on databases or web frameworks
Define clear Input and Output Ports with decoupled infrastructure adapters
feynman_prompts: Explain the Clean Architecture Dependency Rule: source code dependencies must point only inward toward higher-level policies.
key_misconceptions: Importing database ORM entities directly into domain business logic Use Cases

nodes.title: Event-Driven Architecture (EDA) & Event Sourcing
nodes.subtitle: Events vs commands, publish-subscribe, Event Sourcing, append-only event logs, state reconstruction
learning_objectives: Design decoupled, event-driven distributed systems using domain events
Implement Event Sourcing where state changes are recorded as an immutable append-only ledger
feynman_prompts: What is the fundamental difference between storing current state vs storing an immutable history of events (Event Sourcing)?
key_misconceptions: Using events as glorified RPC commands, re-introducing tight temporal coupling between services

nodes.title: CQRS: Command Query Responsibility Segregation
nodes.subtitle: Read models vs Write models, eventual consistency, projection workers, denormalized read views
learning_objectives: Separate complex write transaction models from high-performance read projections using CQRS
Build denormalized read-optimized views that update asynchronously via domain events
feynman_prompts: Why does separating the Command model from the Query model unlock massive read-side scalability?
key_misconceptions: Applying full CQRS and Event Sourcing to simple CRUD applications that don't need it

nodes.title: API Strategy, Protocols & Contract Governance
nodes.subtitle: REST, GraphQL, gRPC, Protobuf, versioning strategies (URI, header), backward compatibility, OpenAPI
learning_objectives: Select optimal communication protocols: REST for public APIs, gRPC for low-latency internal microservices
Enforce strict backward compatibility and semantic API versioning across teams
feynman_prompts: Why is gRPC significantly faster and more bandwidth-efficient than REST/JSON for microservice-to-microservice traffic?
key_misconceptions: Introducing breaking API schema changes without versioning, crashing downstream client applications

nodes.title: Enterprise Integration Patterns (EIP)
nodes.subtitle: Content-based router, message translator, scatter-gather, dead-letter channel, idempotent receiver
learning_objectives: Apply classic Enterprise Integration Patterns to connect disparate legacy and cloud systems
Implement scatter-gather patterns to aggregate responses from multiple backend systems in parallel
feynman_prompts: How does an Idempotent Receiver pattern protect systems from duplicate message processing?
key_misconceptions: Assuming network delivery is reliable and failing to design for message duplication or network timeouts

nodes.title: Data Architecture: Polyglot Persistence & Data Mesh
nodes.subtitle: Relational, document, key-value, graph, time-series, vector databases, Data Mesh principles
learning_objectives: Select optimal storage engines for specific access patterns (Polyglot Persistence)
Apply Data Mesh principles treating data as a product owned by cross-functional domain teams
feynman_prompts: Why is forcing all application data into a single database engine an architectural anti-pattern?
key_misconceptions: Building a single centralized monolithic data lake that becomes an unmaintainable bottleneck

nodes.title: Security Architecture & Zero Trust Principles
nodes.subtitle: Identity providers (OAuth2/OIDC), zero trust network access (ZTNA), defense-in-depth, STRIDE
learning_objectives: Architect enterprise authentication and authorization using OAuth 2.0 and OpenID Connect
Enforce defense-in-depth where every internal network layer authenticates and encrypts requests
feynman_prompts: Why does Zero Trust require mutual TLS and identity verification even for traffic inside private networks?
key_misconceptions: Assuming the internal corporate or cloud VPC network is trusted and safe from lateral movement

nodes.title: Resilience Engineering: Fault Tolerance & Chaos
nodes.subtitle: Blast radius reduction, graceful degradation, circuit breakers, load shedding, chaos engineering
learning_objectives: Minimize failure blast radius so that an outage in one subsystem does not take down the entire business
Design systems capable of graceful degradation under catastrophic load (dropping non-critical features)
feynman_prompts: How does load shedding intentionally drop low-priority requests to save a server from total collapse?
key_misconceptions: Designing systems where every single component must be 100% operational for any feature to work

nodes.title: Architecture Documentation: The C4 Model & ADRs
nodes.subtitle: C4 Model (Context, Containers, Components, Code), Architecture Decision Records (ADRs)
learning_objectives: Communicate complex software architectures clearly using C4 Model hierarchical diagrams
Document architectural rationale, trade-offs, and decisions using Architecture Decision Records (ADRs)
feynman_prompts: Why are Architecture Decision Records (ADRs) critical for preserving institutional architectural memory?
key_misconceptions: Drawing unstandardized architectural boxes-and-arrows diagrams with undefined boundary semantics

nodes.title: Legacy Modernization & The Strangler Fig Pattern
nodes.subtitle: Strangler Fig pattern, anti-corruption layers (ACL), branch by abstraction, database migration
learning_objectives: Incrementally replace legacy monolithic systems using the Strangler Fig pattern without downtime
Isolate new clean systems from legacy domain pollution using Anti-Corruption Layers (ACL)
feynman_prompts: Why is the Strangler Fig pattern vastly superior to risky high-stakes 'big bang' rewrites?
key_misconceptions: Attempting a complete ground-up rewrite of a massive legacy system from scratch in one release

nodes.title: Architecting for NFRs: Availability, Latency & SLAs
nodes.subtitle: NFR engineering, 99.9% vs 99.99% availability math, p99 latency budgeting, scalability metrics
learning_objectives: Calculate composite availability and downtime allowances for complex multi-tier dependencies
Translate ambiguous business goals into concrete, measurable Non-Functional Requirements (NFRs)
feynman_prompts: Explain why four nines (99.99%) availability permits only 4.38 minutes of total downtime per month.
key_misconceptions: Accepting requirements like 'the system must be fast and never go down' without concrete metrics

nodes.title: Cloud Cost Engineering & FinOps Architecture
nodes.subtitle: Cloud cost optimization, compute right-sizing, spot instances, egress cost architecture, FinOps
learning_objectives: Architect systems that minimize cloud data transfer and cross-region egress costs
Establish FinOps visibility matching cloud infrastructure spend directly to business unit revenue
feynman_prompts: How does cross-availability-zone data transfer quietly generate massive unexpected cloud bills?
key_misconceptions: Over-provisioning cloud compute clusters without autoscaling or utilization analysis

nodes.title: Technical Governance & Evolutionary Architecture
nodes.subtitle: Fitness functions, architectural guardrails, RFC review processes, managing technical debt
learning_objectives: Automate architectural rule compliance using automated fitness functions in CI
Lead collaborative Request for Comments (RFC) processes that build engineering consensus
feynman_prompts: What is an architectural fitness function and how does it prevent architectural drift over time?
key_misconceptions: Acting as an ivory-tower architect who dictates designs without consulting implementing engineers

nodes.title: AI & LLM Architecture Integration in Enterprise
nodes.subtitle: LLM gateways, prompt orchestration, RAG architectures, model evaluation, AI cost & latency controls
learning_objectives: Integrate Large Language Models into enterprise architectures using modular RAG pipelines
Design AI gateways providing rate limiting, cost monitoring, fallback models, and guardrails
feynman_prompts: Why must enterprise architectures isolate LLM calls behind an abstraction gateway rather than direct API calls?
key_misconceptions: Allowing raw un-sanitized user input directly into LLM prompts without validation guardrails

description: Master Software Architect with an industry-standard, comprehensive curriculum spanning 18 core and advanced milestones.
